name: Share of Sweet
source:
It's like in real life, there are ups and downs! Meet girls and develop relationships with your loved ones... Become a hero in the harsh reality and show who is in charge of the house!

This visual novel tells about the life trials of a young man who faced a series of tragic events that changed his fate. Currently, he is going through a difficult period, balancing between helping loved ones, fighting inner demons and preserving his sanity. However, the main character wants a better life...

Create your own path to triumph and happiness together with the hero, exploring and discovering all sides of your dark or light self.

[Edited from Itch.io]
translation:
就像现实生活一样，有起有落！认识女孩并与你所爱的人发展关系…成为严酷现实中的英雄并表明谁才是这个家的主人！

这部视觉小说讲述了一个年轻人的人生考验，他面临着一系列改变他命运的悲惨事件。目前，他正在经历一段艰难的时期，在帮助亲人、对抗内心的恶魔和保持理智之间取得平衡。然而，主角想要更好的生活……

与英雄一起创造你自己的胜利和幸福之路，探索和发现你黑暗或光明的自我的各个方面。

[编辑自Itch.io]
